messages:
leo (eng-ml): Quick sync — ran the int6 quant sweep on the new candidate (nova14b-2026-03). TL;DR: int6 is materially cheaper, small quality deltas on most slices, one notable longform regression. Need a quick decision for GTN routing and a canary plan.
anya (ml): can you paste the scorecard and the perf numbers?
leo (eng-ml): pasted below — short block, numbers from the smoke runs on production-sampled traffic (~5k requests):
```
model: nova14b-2026-03
configs: fp16 (baseline), int8, int6
latency p50/p95 (ms): fp16 42/110, int8 45/120, int6 48/130
tokens/sec: fp16 200, int8 210, int6 230
quality (QA EM / rouge-l on eval set): fp16 91.4 / 37.6, int8 91.2 / 37.5, int6 90.9 / 37.2
unit token cost (approx): fp16 $0.0019, int8 $0.0012, int6 $0.00085
notes: int6 reduces token cost ~29% vs int8, latency increase ~+3ms p50, p95 impact small but visible on long sequences
```
sam (prod): thanks — that cost delta is significant. what about slice-level regressions? any >1pt EM drops?
leo (eng-ml): only one meaningful slice: longform summarization (>2k tokens) shows ~0.8 EM drop int6 vs int8 and p95 latency spikes ~+60ms there. other slices (multi-turn chat, short answers, rerank) are within 0.2 EM. No correctness regressions on rerank top-1 in our sampled traffic.
anya (ml): nice. My take: int6 is fine for chat and short Q&A. longform needs either int8 or cached prefixes / prefix-KV warmstart. We can route longform to int8 and enable int6 for default.
vic (gtn): product question — is it safe to recommend int6 as the default in GTN for new customers, or do we need staged guidance?
leo (eng-ml): recommend staged: default int6 for chat-like routes, int8 for longform and high-risk generation (e.g., legal/finance prompts). Canary for 24-72h at 20-30% traffic with quality probes. Add auto-fallback to int8 if eval probe score drops >1.0 EM or error rate rises >0.5%.
anya (ml): I can own the quality probes / prompt set. Suggest probes: 150 chat prompts, 50 longform, 30 rerank tests, run every 5m during canary.
deploy-bot: canary rule created: id=r-7890, start=2026-03-18T16:20:00Z, traffic=25%, fallback=compatible-int8, alert-channel=#eng-ml (ops).
sam (prod): +1. add rollback automation: if probe quality drops >1.5 EM or latency p95 increases >40% for 30m, roll back to 0%. Also log token-econ delta in console experiment panel.
leo (eng-ml): will draft rollout checklist: canary config, probe dashboard, SLOs, rollback triggers, communication note for GTN. Assigning @anya to own eval dashboard and alert thresholds.
anya (ml): on it — will post the dashboard link and the initial 24h snapshot once the canary stabilizes.
vic (gtn): I'll draft the GTN advisory: "Recommended default: int6 for chat routes; int8 for longform/high-risk. Canary first; monitor probes; fallback configured." Will share copy for review.
leo (eng-ml): decision: proceed with canary now. Monitoring and probes in place. If 24h snapshot looks clean, we propose default routing change for new GTN tenants. Will keep notes in the onboarding doc. :thumbsup:
anya (ml): thanks — pinging #product for visibility.
sam (prod): thanks team.
leo (eng-ml): closing thread — will follow up with rollout doc and canary results.
